text:
maria: FYI seeing a sustained tail in p50->p95 on us-west dedicated slice-7 since the 03:10 deploy. Noticed higher NVLink retransmits and PCIe util climbing.

simon: ugh, slice-7 again? any tenant ids? can we confirm it's egress or internal fabric?

maria: initial check: kube metrics show batch-job-tenant-42 spiking to 3x normal mem-copy / KV cache regen. NIC tx queues also jittering. NVLink counters -> high peer-to-peer stalls.

lee: sounds like a cross-tenant PCIe/NVLink saturation problem rather than pure CPU. Any correlation with recent model + quantize rollouts?

anita: tenant-42 rolled a larger context-model yesterday that does long prefix decodes. We've seen warm-cache churn earlier, but not this level of hw-level contention.

maria: timeline: 03:10 deploy -> 03:25 p50 drift -> 03:30 p95 spikes. Stack traces point to KV eviction storms and very frequent cudaMemcpy.

simon: can we throttle that tenant at the routing layer as a quick mitigation? maybe drop them to cold lane or route to preemptible pool.

lee: we have an egress policer experiment in eu that uses tc + fq_codel on the sidecar. Could re-use to shape NVLink heavy paths by tagging by tenant in proxy.

anita: short term I'd prefer routing to a warm-but-isolated slice (dedicated warm pool) rather than throttle, to preserve QoS for the tenant but protect others.

maria: agreed. two prongs: 1) emergency steer tenant-42 to dedicated-warm-02 2) apply soft egress cap 200MB/s on host NIC for that tenant's flows for 10m. Anyone have quick commands?

lee: for tc-based soft cap on iface eth0 (example):

```
# shape tenant flows by cgroup mark
tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: htb default 12
tc class add dev eth0 parent 1: classid 1:12 htb rate 200mbit ceil 200mbit
# iptables to mark packets from pod cgroup
iptables -t mangle -A OUTPUT -m cgroup --cgroup 12345 -j MARK --set-mark 42
tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip handle 42 fw flowid 1:12
```

simon: we can't rely on cgroup indexing easily in prod sidecars. alternative: mark by src IP range from tenant's pod CIDR.

anita: I pushed a quick router rule to the allocation sequencer to prefer dedicated-warm-02 for tenant-42. ops-bot should have the action logged.

ops-bot: Action logged: routed tenant=tenant-42 -> pool=dedicated-warm-02 by user=anita at 2026-03-21T03:37:12Z

maria: nice. can we also set a temporary placement policy: no colocated noisy-tenants on same host for 1h, soft quarantine? we'd rather avoid a repeat.

lee: putting a placement anti-affinity label on the tenant is doable: set annotation routing/anti_colocate=true with ttl=3600. I'll enqueue.

simon: longer term: we need signal aggregation: NVLink retransmits should feed the allocation decision. Right now we look at host-level GPU mem and CPU but not fabric stalls.

anita: +1. Proposal: add NVLink/PCIe stall metric as a first-class signal in the allocator. Weight it similar to nic_saturation metric.

maria: for rollback: if dedicated-warm-02 gets saturated, auto-fallback to preemptible fallback-pool and alert. deploy-bot - can you add the canary fallback rule to the orchestration config?

deploy-bot: Canary fallback rule added to rollback-policy v2.9 by deploy-bot at 2026-03-21T03:42:05Z

simon: quick ask: can the billing team be notified? this steering will move tenant-42 to dedicated capacity which affects reserved accounting.

anita: pinging billing in the thread and adding tag billing:dedicated-override. I'll create an invoice flag if they remain >2h.

maria: monitoring items before closing: 1) p95 latency normalizes in 10m 2) NVLink retransmit rate drops 3) no new tenants hit the same host. I'll watch and report.

lee: if we see recurrence, we should consider fractional dedicated carveouts per-tenant for long-context models. not full dedicated pools, but pinned slice lanes.

simon: sounds good. I'll file a follow-up RFC to add fabric metrics to allocator + proposal for per-tenant fractional carveouts.

maria: thanks all. leaving alert open until 04:00 PT. will update on the thread.

anita: thanks, closing temporary steering now but leaving the anti-colocate annotation active.

maria: p95 down to baseline, NVLink stalls reduced. closing incident at 03:55 PT. :thumbsup:
